site.name: ideasos
site.standfirst: Open source ideas for working with agents. Every idea is a markdown file with a licence, a verified date, and a twin your agent can read. Some are guides your agent can install and walk. Some are how-tos. Some are just worth thinking about.
site.disclosure: Tool links are plain links. Some may become referral links; they cost you nothing, and this line will say which.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.blurb: Anthropic's agent in your terminal. In these drawings it is the box that runs the commands on your behalf.

hostinger-vps.name: Hostinger VPS
hostinger-vps.blurb: A small Linux box with a public address. Any VPS works; this is the one we run.

caddy.name: Caddy
caddy.blurb: The web server in front of everything. Automatic HTTPS, and a forward_auth directive that makes a gate one line.

python.name: Python 3
python.blurb: Already on the box. Doorman needs 3.10 or newer and the venv module.

github.name: GitHub
github.blurb: Where the code lives. The guide clones straight from the repository.

tailscale.name: Tailscale
tailscale.blurb: A private network between your devices, so a laptop can reach a server without a port open to the world.

slack.name: Slack
slack.blurb: The one room a human and two bots can enter without sharing a login.

entries.title: One login for every site you own
entries.summary: A passkey in front of every site on your domain: Doorman behind Caddy, about a thousand lines of Python.
entries.parts: vps · caddy · python · github · claude code
entries.flow: you@local[You] -> cc@local[Claude Code] : what to do; cc -> doorman@server[Doorman] : ssh; github@cloud[GitHub] -> doorman : git clone; doorman -> db@server[auth.db] : keys; caddy@server[Caddy] -> doorman : forward_auth; visitor@cloud[A visitor] -> caddy : https; phone@cloud[Your passkey] -> caddy : passkey

entries.title: They don't share a brain. They share a hallway.
entries.summary: Two AI desks on two subscriptions, one Slack room between them, and the rules that keep it from becoming noise.
